value.rationale: The model is an established noninteracting resetting gas. Its one-time current is exactly Poisson, yet temporal averaging does not self-average over frozen random anchors; the long-time mean has the nondegenerate generalized Dickman law. The explicitly evaluated all-lag covariance and one-quarter plateau quantify precisely how environmental disorder survives infinite time while dynamic conditional covariance vanishes. This directly addresses the experimentally/statistically meaningful difference between stationary marginals, dynamic memory and ensemble-averaged long-time measurements; it is not a textbook normalization check or arbitrary parameter slice.
